GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 383.6 (20 Sep 46) GB/CIS
(SCAPIN - 1220)
APO 500
20 September 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Release of Japanese Nationals.
1. The Imperial Japanese Government is advised that the following named Japanese nationals have been released from Sugamo Prison:
Name Interned
OGIWARA, Saburo 15 Jan. 1946
MATSUMURA, Sakuji 4 Feb. 1946
ONO, Katsuzane 6 Frb. 1946
HIJIAKA, Nobuo 8 Aug. 1946
2. The Imperial Japanese Government is further advised that upon apprehension of TANAKA, Masao and SHIRAO, Kunimitsu, the four(4) individuals referred to in paragraph 1 above will be made available on 24-hours' notice upon request of Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
3. The six (6) Japanese nationals named herein were ordered apprehended per Memorandum AG 383.6 (7 Jan 46)CIS, Subject: "Apprehension of Japanese Personnel"(SCAPIN560), dated 7 January 1946.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
